mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app.focus_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'PAUSED')

SELECT f.id AS "sessionId", f.task_id AS "taskId", f.status, f.version::text AS version, FALSE AS "isCurrentController", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.focus_segment s WHERE s.session_id = f.id AND s.interruption_repairable) AS "requiresTimeRepair" FROM app.focus_session f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status IN ('RUNNING', 'PAUSED') ORDER BY f.started_at, f.id LIMIT 100
